conditions: Initial detached test, then simultaneous load and thermal equilibrium
acceptance: At least 4.5 V once regulated, including load transients; no repeated UVLO startup cycling. Confirm correct polarity before connecting J2.

conditions: Detached loads 0/400/750 mA and 100-750 mA steps, then assembled simultaneous load
acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band including ripple and load transients after regulation; inspect startup/shutdown separately.

positive_probe: ZAC93 physical pin 1, at the module
ground_probe: ZAC93 physical pin 6, at the module
conditions: Simultaneous load including Z-Wave transmission, cold start and thermal equilibrium
acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band at the cable destination, including ripple and load transients. Check both ZAC93 ground leads by unpowered continuity first.

conditions: Measure simultaneously with U1 local 3V3 during peak load and at thermal equilibrium
acceptance: Apply host_input_rule: VIN-VOUT must exceed the fitted regulator's guaranteed dropout at the tested current and temperature, plus ripple/measurement margin. Record the bound and measured minimum headroom in notes; no fixed 4.5 V pass threshold applies here.

conditions: Cold start, three BLE connections and all hub protocols active, through thermal equilibrium
acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band after regulation, including ripple and transients; no brownout/restart. The WROVER-IE operating range is 3.0-3.6 V; that wider range is not a substitute for this design target or the separate dropout check.

conditions: Cold start, Thread radio traffic, host-controlled reset and thermal equilibrium
acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band after regulation, including ripple and transients. The U2 header 5 V path has its own onboard diode and regulator; a good peripheral rail does not qualify this local rail.

conditions: Cold start, Zigbee transmissions and thermal equilibrium
acceptance: Project 3.3 V +/-5% band after regulation, including ripple and transients. Check at the local regulator output; do not infer it from J2 or connect it to J2.3.

conditions: Cold power-up and host EN reset, with WIZ850io and actual CC1101 connected
acceptance: Remain at or below 0.25 times measured U1 local VDD during the datasheet strap-sampling interval around EN release. Use a scope; a later SPI waveform or DMM average cannot establish the boot level. GPIO12 LOW selects 3.3 V VDD_SDIO.

conditions: Host EN reset with GPIO0 held LOW by J9 service short; all modules attached, no powered USB
acceptance: Remain at or below 0.25 times measured U1 local VDD during the datasheet strap-sampling interval. This verifies the GPIO2 condition for UART download; it does not qualify USB power isolation or prove a complete flash operation. Remove J9 short afterwards.
